- 실행할 파이프라인 설정: 파이프라인 실행 > 설정 > 호출할 파이프라인 선택
- Input log: 파이프라인 실행 전 Oracle 로깅 func 호출
  - 설정 > 쿼리 부분 파이프라인 명 변경
- Output Success log: 실행 후 성공 시 func 호출
- Output Error log: 실행 후 에러 시 func 호출
  - 설정 > 쿼리 부분 파이프라인 명 변경

*Oracle에서 데이터를 갖고 오는 파이프라인의 경우에만 Input 성공 -> 파이프라인 실행(이외 Input 완료 -> 파이프라인 실행)

select 
 split_part(a.brand_name,'[',1)as keyword
from cd_ods.tb_fc_disclosures_kftc_t a
where clos_ym  = '202605'
and not exists (select 1 from cd_ods.tb_fc_brand_insta_temp where keyword = a.brand_name)

SELECT replace(keyword,'''','''''') AS key1, 
CASE WHEN COALESCE (synonym, '') != '' THEN replace(keyword,'''','''''') ||'||'||replace(synonym,'''','''''')
     ELSE replace(keyword,'''','''''') END AS key2
FROM cd_ods.tb_fc_news_keyword_t
WHERE 1=1
AND seq between @{int(variables('no'))} *1000 - 999 and @{int(variables('no'))} *1000
ORDER BY key1 , key2

SELECT DISTINCT  CAST(seq / 1000 + 1 AS varchar) as cnt
FROM cd_ods.tb_fc_news_keyword_t
order by cnt

select a.gubun 
      ,a.keyword
      ,string_agg(a.inculde_keyword,',') as inculde_keyword
      ,a.inculde_keyword_and
      ,inculde_keyword_add||string_agg(a.inculde_keyword,'||')||inculde_keyword_add2  as api_inculde_keyword
      ,string_agg(a.db_inculde_keyword,',') as db_inculde_keyword
  from (
	    select gubun
	          ,keyword		        
	          ,inculde_keyword_and
	          ,inculde_keyword
	          ,case when length(inculde_keyword_and) !=0 then inculde_keyword_and||'&&(' else '' end  inculde_keyword_add
              ,case when length(inculde_keyword_and) !=0 then ')' else '' end inculde_keyword_add2
	          ,replace(inculde_keyword,'''','''''')  as db_inculde_keyword
	          ,row_number() over (partition by gubun, keyword, inculde_keyword_and)/20 as cnt 
	      from cd_portal.tb_kimchi_roh_news_keyword 
		) a 
 where a.gubun = '김치'
 group by a.gubun 
      ,a.keyword
      ,a.inculde_keyword_and
      ,a.inculde_keyword_add
      ,a.inculde_keyword_add2
 order by keyword
SELECT cd_ods.kimchi_roh_news_data('@{variables('date')}' , '@{variables('date2')}' ) AS rtn

select min(a.base_date) as strdt
      ,max(a.base_date) as enddt
 from (
    select to_char(base_date,'YYYYMMDD') as base_date
          ,row_number() over (order by base_date desc)/5 as pri
     from cd_ods.aps_sdc_pw_mst
    where cmonth2 between '202406' and '202406'
      and  to_char(base_date,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN '20240622' AND '20240624'
     ) a
group by a.pri     
order by a.pri

select a.gubun 
      ,a.keyword
      ,string_agg(a.inculde_keyword,',') as inculde_keyword
      ,a.inculde_keyword_and
      ,inculde_keyword_add||string_agg(a.inculde_keyword,'||')||inculde_keyword_add2  as api_inculde_keyword
      ,string_agg(a.db_inculde_keyword,',') as db_inculde_keyword
  from (
	    select gubun
	          ,keyword		        
	          ,inculde_keyword_and
	          ,inculde_keyword
	          ,case when length(inculde_keyword_and) !=0 then inculde_keyword_and||'&&(' else '' end  inculde_keyword_add
              ,case when length(inculde_keyword_and) !=0 then ')' else '' end inculde_keyword_add2
	          ,replace(inculde_keyword,'''','''''')  as db_inculde_keyword
	          ,row_number() over (partition by gubun, keyword, inculde_keyword_and)/20 as cnt 
	      from cd_portal.tb_kimchi_roh_news_keyword2 
		) a 
 where a.gubun = '김치'
 group by a.gubun 
      ,a.keyword
      ,a.inculde_keyword_and
      ,a.inculde_keyword_add
      ,a.inculde_keyword_add2
 order by keyword

SELECT  regexp_replace(keyword, '[()]', '', 'g') AS keyword
FROM 
(
SELECT string_agg(keyword, '||') AS keyword, cnt
FROM (
SELECT keyword
,row_number() over (ORDER  BY keyword) / 10 as cnt
from(
SELECT DISTINCT  keyword AS keyword 
FROM cd_ods.tb_fc_news_keyword_t
WHERE COALESCE (use_yn,'Y') != 'N'
UNION 
SELECT DISTINCT synonym AS keyword 
FROM cd_ods.tb_fc_news_keyword_t
WHERE COALESCE (use_yn,'Y') != 'N'
AND COALESCE (synonym,'') != ''
) a
) a
GROUP BY cnt
ORDER BY cnt
) a

WITH VW_DATE AS
  (   
    SELECT -1 * (LEVEL-1)              AS SDATE
          ,(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL-1)) AS SDATE2
      FROM (
             SELECT TO_DATE('2021-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')   AS STR_DATE
                   ,(TRUNC(SYSDATE)-1)                   AS END_DATE            
                FROM DUAL
           )
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= -1 * ( -2 + STR_DATE - END_DATE )   -- 일수 토탈 
  )
  SELECT round(SDATE) AS "date"
    FROM VW_DATE 
    WHERE SDATE != 0 
   ORDER BY SDATE

source.oracleReaderQuery:
WITH VW_DATE AS
  (   
    SELECT -1 * (LEVEL-1)              AS SDATE
          ,(TRUNC(SYSDATE) - (LEVEL-1)) AS SDATE2
      FROM (
             SELECT TO_DATE('2021-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AS STR_DATE
                   ,(TRUNC(SYSDATE))                   AS END_DATE            
                FROM DUAL
           )
    CONNECT BY LEVEL <= -1 * ( -1 + STR_DATE - END_DATE )   -- 일수 토탈 
  )
  SELECT round(SDATE) AS "date"
    FROM VW_DATE
  -- WHERE SDATE2 BETWEEN TO_DATE('2022-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD') AND  TO_DATE('2022-12-31','YYYY-MM-DD')
   ORDER BY SDATE

select keyword     
        ,exclude_keyword
        ,include_keyword
        ,include_keyword_and
        ,case when include_keyword_and is not null then '('||include_keyword_and||')&('||include_keyword||')'
              else include_keyword
          end include_keyword_api
   from  cd_ods.tb_global_news_keyword

delete from cd_ods.tb_global_news_data where date between '@{variables('date')}' and '@{variables('date2')}';

insert into cd_ods.tb_global_news_data
(
 "date" 
	,gubun
	,keyword
	,include_keyword
	,exclude_keyword 
	,include_keyword_and
	,title
	,url
	,writername 
	,writerrealname 
	,documentdate
	,select_include_keyword
)
     select  a.date
	,a.gubun
	,a.keyword
	,a.include_keyword
	,a.exclude_keyword 
	,a.include_keyword_and
	,a.title
	,a.url
	,a.writername 
	,a.writerrealname 
	,a.documentdate
            ,array_to_string ( array_agg(distinct a.select_inculde_keyword),',' ) as select_include_keyword            
        from (
		         select "date" 
						,gubun	
						,keyword
						,include_keyword
						,exclude_keyword 
						,include_keyword_and
						,title
						,url
						,writername 
						,writerrealname 
						,documentdate
					    ,regexp_matches(title||' '||content , replace(include_keyword,'||','|') ,'g') as select_inculde_keyword			   
						from cd_ods.tb_global_news_data_temp					
					where date between '@{variables('date')}' and '@{variables('date2')}'
					 and replace(writername,' ','') not in
								 (
								  '일간스포츠'
								  , 'MBC연예'
								  , '오마이뉴스'
								  , '코메디닷컴'
								  , '스포티비뉴스'
								  , '연합뉴스TN'
								  , '스타뉴스'
								  , 'OSEN'
								 )
				--	and title ='백화점부터 도서관까지…기능성 천장재 도입 사례 확산'
                 ) a
     group by  a.date
	,a.gubun
	,a.keyword
	,a.include_keyword
	,a.exclude_keyword 
	,a.include_keyword_and
	,a.title
	,a.url
	,a.writername 
	,a.writerrealname 
	,a.documentdate    ;            
                 
select 1 as su;

SELECT item_code 
, CASE WHEN item_code  = '0000000' THEN regid

WHERE to_char(now(), 'mm-dd') BETWEEN begindate AND enddate 
AND COALESCE(obsr_Spot_Code ,'') !=''

, x, y FROM 
(
SELECT a.obsr_spot_code , a.obsr_spot_nm , b.areano  , c.x, c.y
FROM cd_ods.tb_apis_agri_weather_spot_code_t a
JOIN cd_ods.tb_kimchi_area_mapping_t b
ON a.obsr_spot_code  = b.code 
AND b.gbn  = '4'
LEFT JOIN cd_ods.tb_apis_area_master_t c
ON b.areano  = c.areano 
) a
;

      and if_date >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
      and if_date < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day'
)

    case
        when y.year_cnt = 0 then 1  
        when t.today_cnt = 0 then 0      
        when y.max_st = 0 then 1
        else y.max_st + 1000
    end as st,
    case
        when y.year_cnt = 0 then 1000     
        when t.today_cnt = 0 then 0     
        when y.max_ed = 0 then 1000
        else y.max_ed + 1000
    end as ed
from year_data y

query.value:
select no, clos_ym, registration_num, store_id, store_name, brand_store_address_full
from (
	select a.no, a.clos_ym,  a.registration_num, a.store_id, a.store_name, a.brand_store_address_full,
	b.sido, b.sigungu, b.dong 
	from (select * from 
			(
			select no, clos_ym,registration_num , store_id, store_name, regexp_replace(
    regexp_replace(
        regexp_replace(
            regexp_replace(split_part( brand_store_address_full, '-',1), '\s*\(.*$', ''),      
            '(^|\s)(\S+)\s+\2', '\1\2', 'g'            
        ),
        '\s+', ' ', 'g'
    ),
    '(\d+(?:번길|대로|로|길)|\d+)(-\d+)?\s.*$', '\1'
) as brand_store_address_full
			, rank() over( partition by registration_num,store_id order by clos_ym desc) as rnk
			from cd_ods.tb_fc_brandstores_navermap_t 
			)
			where rnk = 1
			) a 
	left join cd_ods.tb_fc_brandstores_real_address_t b
	on a.store_id  = b.store_id 
	and a.registration_num  = b.registration_num 
)
where 1=1
and coalesce (sido, '') = ''
order by clos_ym desc, no desc
limit 5000

WITH id_pw_combinations AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER () as combo_id,
    id, 
    pw
  FROM (
    VALUES 
      ('p7kCTjIvjnAYEJGAvsl0', 'fabaTiAHhF'),
      ('YGhFoYAuLjwOeggaogEg', '2fBbQxicmX'),
      ('JKMVVBdEU58bv9gVHyeh', 'spp0sh3TAq')
  ) AS combinations(id, pw)
),
base_data AS (
  SELECT 
    topic,
    key_id,
    to_char(now() - interval '8 day', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as start_date,
     to_char(now() - interval '2 day', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as end_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER () as row_num
  FROM cd_portal.tb_topic_master
  where use_yn = 'Y'
and new_traker  = 'N'
)
SELECT 
  bd.topic,
  bd.key_id,
  bd.start_date,
  bd.end_date,
  ipc.id,
  ipc.pw
FROM base_data bd
JOIN id_pw_combinations ipc ON ipc.combo_id = ((bd.row_num - 1) % 3) + 1

query.value:
select a.gubun   
      ,a.reason 
      ,a.keyword
      ,string_agg(a.include_keyword,',') as include_keyword
      ,a.exclude_keyword 
      ,string_agg(a.include_keyword,'||') as api_include_keyword
      , case when replace(a.exclude_keyword ,',','||') = '' then '%23%40VK%23S1%23%EC%A0%95%EC%B9%98'
            else replace(a.exclude_keyword ,',','||')  || '%23%40VK%23S1%23%EC%A0%95%EC%B9%98'
            end as api_exclude_keyword_new
      ,replace(a.exclude_keyword ,',','||') as api_exclude_keyword
  from (
		select gubun   
		      ,reason 
		      ,keyword		    
		      ,exclude_keyword 
		      ,case when regexp_match( include_keyword,',') is not null then '('||replace(include_keyword,',','&&')||')'
		            else include_keyword
		        end include_keyword         
		  from cd_ods.tb_srm_news_keyword
       ) a              
group by  a.gubun   
      ,a.reason 
      ,a.keyword  
       ,a.exclude_keyword 
order by a.gubun, a.reason, a.keyword
;

truncate table cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_order_detail_date;

insert into cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_order_detail_date
with use_dt as
(
SELECT
    cast(order_detail_id as varchar) as order_detail_id,
    STRING_AGG(use_date, ',' ORDER BY use_date) AS use_date
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        order_detail_id,
        substr( use_date, 6, length(use_date)) as use_date
    FROM cd_ods.tb_eat_order_detail_date
    where order_detail_id in 
    (
    		select order_detail_id from cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_order_detail
    )
) t
GROUP BY
    order_detail_id
)
select * from use_dt;

select 1 as success

            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '47'::text THEN '경상북도'::text
            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '48'::text THEN '경상남도'::text
            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '46'::text THEN '전라남도'::text
            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '29'::text THEN '광주광역시'::text
            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '45'::text THEN '전라북도'::text
            WHEN substr(f."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '50'::text THEN '제주특별자치도'::text
        END = h.sido
 and h.brname = c.brand_bluesis 
 and h.pname = c.product_name_bluesis 
 and h.rep = 'O'
 )
 where 1=1
 and name IS NOT NULL
  AND name ~ '[a-zA-Z가-힣]'
  and bidid not in  (select bidid from cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_order_detail_new)
AND NOT EXISTS 
(  
      SELECT 1  
      FROM cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_order_detail_keyword_except ke  
      WHERE 
      (
      	 	  name = ke.keyword 
      	 	or spec = ke.keyword
      )  
)
 ;

select 1 as ss;

select string_agg('{  "source": { "name": "'||a.sour||'", "type": "String" }, "sink": {  "name": "'||a.sink||'", "type": "String", "physicalType": "character varying" } }'
              ,',') as json
  from (
		select distinct column_name as sour
		      ,case when column_name lIke 'CSTM%' and hierarchy_level = '1' then 'category'
		            else lower(hierarchy_level_name)
		         end sink
		 from  cd_ods.tb_nielsen_offline_hier_temp
		 where data_type ='@{item().fileName}'
		  union all 
		select 'hierarchy_number','hierarchy_number' union all
		select 'hierarchy_level','hierarchy_level'   union all
		select 'hierarchy_level_name','hierarchy_level_name' 	
	) a

SELECT bidid
	   FROM ( SELECT a.bidid,
                CASE
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '11'::text THEN '서울특별시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '41'::text THEN '경기도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '28'::text THEN '인천광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '42'::text THEN '강원특별자치도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '44'::text THEN '충청남도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '30'::text THEN '대전광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '35'::text THEN '세종특별자치시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '43'::text THEN '충청북도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '26'::text THEN '부산광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '31'::text THEN '울산광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '27'::text THEN '대구광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '47'::text THEN '경상북도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '48'::text THEN '경상남도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '46'::text THEN '전라남도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '29'::text THEN '광주광역시'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '45'::text THEN '전라북도'::text
                    WHEN substr(b."상위 코드", 1, 2) = '50'::text THEN '제주특별자치도'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END AS new_sido
           FROM cd_ods.tb_sf_eat_bid_master a
              JOIN ( SELECT *
                   FROM cd_ods.tb_mdm_school_info
                  WHERE 1 = 1 AND (tb_mdm_school_info."담당 기관 사업자번호" IN ( SELECT tb_mdm_school_info_1."담당 기관 사업자번호"
                           FROM cd_ods.tb_mdm_school_info tb_mdm_school_info_1
                          GROUP BY tb_mdm_school_info_1."담당 기관 사업자번호"
                         HAVING count(*) = 1))) b ON a.org_biz_id::text = b."담당 기관 사업자번호"
          WHERE 1=1
          and a.postdate between '2026-02-01' and '2026-02-28'
          ) unnamed_subquery
 	 WHERE new_sido <> ALL (ARRAY['서울특별시'::text, '경기도'::text, '인천광역시'::text, ''::text])
